name: tripflix-visobert-binary-finetune-v1

review_confirmation.scope: 80 added labels confirmed unchanged; original 240 labels previously reviewed

split.stratification: provided focus or kind, sampled by group_id

supervision: binary cross entropy over clean versus logsumexp(offensive,hate)

selection.checkpoint: minimum validation binary NLL including original epoch 0
selection.threshold: maximize validation target recall with FP <= original model FP at threshold 0.97; ties by F1 then fewer FP; validation only

limits: Small synthetic dataset, one split and one training seed.
Validation is used for checkpoint and threshold selection.
Separate offensive/hate semantics are not supervised by binary labels.
Existing group IDs track base sentences and new contrastive pairs; shared broader template families may still cross splits.
300 seen examples are regression data; final generalization needs fresh test data.
